decision: Selected the centroid of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcel 083-31-026 (situs 1656 MCCARTHY BL, MILPITAS 95035), the parcel at the address CoreSite gives for SV2, as the site locator of CoreSite SV2. It locates the parcel, not the building footprint.
layer: County of Santa Clara Parcels (Socrata dataset ubcd-cewv on data.sccgov.org), GeoJSON in WGS84; rows carry APN, situs address and jurisdiction only (no owner fields)

computed.method: Union of the parcel polygon(s); centroid computed in EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N) and returned to WGS84; EPSG:5070 and EPSG:3310 cross-checks give the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: CoreSite's Silicon Valley market page (version of 9 October 2026; Internet Archive copy of 11 October 2026 and live copy of 6 November 2026) and its SV2 page give 'CoreSite SV2 - Milpitas Data Center, 1656 McCarthy Blvd., Milpitas, CA 95035'.
A query of the county Parcels dataset for situs house number 1656 on MCCARTHY in MILPITAS returns exactly one parcel, 08331026 (zip 95035-7417, jurisdiction Milpitas, one situs address).
excluded: No geocoder, commercial map, PeeringDB, city centre or company map pin is used.
